panelImport.entry.title: Find panels in a scan, or slice a long manuscript into cards
panelImport.entry.privacy: This tool processes images only on this device and does not send them to a server. After panels are inserted into a Studio document, Studio’s own saving and sync rules apply. Use only manuscripts you own or have permission to use.

panelImport.mode.reflow.title: Auto panel detection · vertical rearrange
panelImport.mode.reflow.body: Find panel borders in a scanned comic page or a long webtoon image, fix them, rearrange into a 690/720 px vertical strip and insert them as Studio panels.
panelImport.mode.cards.title: Card-news slicer (4:5)
panelImport.mode.cards.body: Slice a long vertical manuscript into several 1080×1350 cards for Instagram, cutting in gutters away from balloons and art, and export a ZIP of PNGs.
